threat_event: Card data stolen from branch POS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 120 branches with POS in the card data environment
existing_controls: Segmentation; QSA report on compliance; EDR on POS
treatment_plan: Maintain; point-to-point encryption at all branches by 2027-03-31
owner: Farm Supply security and compliance lead

threat_event: Tenant isolation defect exposes one cooperative's grower data to another
treatment_plan: Add automated cross-tenant tests; independent penetration test
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

threat_event: AI variable-rate prescription error causes over-application or crop damage on growers' fields
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature launched 2026-03-01 without security, privacy, or agronomic validation review
existing_controls: Agronomists can review prescriptions before export
treatment_plan: Retroactive review; rate guardrails; agronomist approval for out-of-range prescriptions (P10)
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

threat_event: Grower credit files with Social Security numbers and personal guarantees are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credit file share readable by 340 accounts
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (worked example); state breach laws
treatment_plan: Restrict to credit staff (about 45 accounts); bulk access alerts

threat_event: Grower data used beyond the portal terms (for example for product analytics)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data-use review for new features
existing_controls: Terms limit use to providing the service
treatment_plan: Data-use review in the release gate
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commitment not in the incident matrix
treatment_plan: Cooperative rows in the matrix with contacts (P08)
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

threat_event: Blending plant controller manipulated to produce wrong blends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controllers on plant networks with vendor remote access through PAM
treatment_plan: Change logging and recipe integrity checks

threat_event: Ransomware halts distribution center warehouse management in planting season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: WMS servers on cloud IaaS with backups; restore never timed
treatment_plan: Timed restore test before planting season

threat_event: Attacker moves from branch office devices into the card data environment
owner: Farm Supply security and compliance lead

threat_event: Precision-ag hardware sold to growers ships with compromised firmware
owner: Farm Supply security and compliance lead

threat_event: Credential stuffing against e-commerce and portal accounts
treatment_plan: MFA by default for cooperative administrators; breached-password checks
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

threat_event: Cooperative administrators provision users for growers who left
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; complementary user entity control in P09
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager

threat_event: Cooperatives move growers to a competitor because no SOC 2 Type 2 report is available
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC 2 report; cooperatives asked for one
treatment_plan: SOC 2 Type 1 as of 2027-03-31, then Type 2 (P09)
owner: Farm Supply digital agronomy general manager
